build_rgba_embed: build an RGBA embedding layer from Minecraft block color data with configurable color IO mode
build_SimpleConv: build a 3D convolutional neural network for voxel block prediction with word and lvar embeddings
build_AE: build a 3D convolutional autoencoder for Minecraft voxel block encoding and decoding
build_GAN: build a GAN with ConvGenerator and ConvDiscriminator for Minecraft voxel block generation
run_color_hash: run color hashing on RGBA tensor values to quantize colors into discrete bins
